_note: Intro Nokon curtain timings. Times in seconds, 'at' times from the start of the fade-in; distances in 1920x1080 pixels; rates in radians per second. A '_min' / '_extra' pair is a random value from min to min + extra.

curtain._note: close_s: the curtain closing (the fade-out); show_s: the show on the shut curtain; open_s: the curtain opening after it. The lights and the name go during the first lights_fade (part, 0 to 1) of the opening; the confetti fades out over the last confetti_fade_s of the fade-in.

lights._note: the lights go down over dim_s; the spotlights circle in from spot_at_s and merge at spot_end_s (the drum roll's crash), turning turns times around, turn_ease and shrink_ease the powers of their turn and of their orbit's shrink; the flash then grows by flash_grow_px from flash_start_size over flash_s

letters._note: the first and the last letter start falling at fall_at_s and fall_last_s, one letter's fall taking fall_s; it lands with a squash of squash over land_s. The first and the last letter start their hop at hop_at_s and hop_last_s (confetti and applause start), one hop taking hop_s, growing by hop_grow and tilting hop_tilt_deg.

confetti._note: speed in px per second; sway in px at sway_rate; spin in degrees per second; flip_rate in radians per second
